title: The degree-zero exchange equation with specified comparisons
statement:
Let $A,B,C,D$ be abelian categories with derived categories and localization functors $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with enough K-injective resolutions in $A$ and $C$. Let $F:A\to B$, $G:B\to D$, $H:A\to C$, and $J:C\to D$ be additive functors, with $G,H$ exact. Write $RF,RJ$ for their total right derived functors [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], and $G_D,H_D$ for the functors on derived categories induced by the exact functors. Write $M[0]$ for the complex with $M$ in degree zero and zero in every other degree. Given natural transformations $e:G F\Rightarrow J H$ and $\delta:G_D RF\Rightarrow RJ H_D$, and specified morphisms and isomorphisms
$$c_F(M):Q(FM[0])\to RF(Q(M[0])),\quad c_J(N):Q(JN[0])\to RJ(Q(N[0])),$$
$$p_G(N):G_D(Q(N[0]))\simeq Q(GN[0]),\quad p_H(M):H_D(Q(M[0]))\simeq Q(HM[0]),$$
define $\operatorname{DerivedDegreeZeroExchangeEquation}(F,G,H,J,e,\delta,c_F,c_J,p_G,p_H,M)$ to be precisely the equality
$$G_D(c_F(M))\,;\,\delta_{Q(M[0])}\,;\,RJ(p_H(M))=p_G(FM)\,;\,Q(e_M[0])\,;\,c_J(HM).$$
Here semicolon denotes composition in the order written, and each isomorphism in the formula denotes its forward morphism. This is a proposition defined by this equality, with no assertion of existence or invertibility of $e$, $\delta$, $c_F$, or $c_J$.

lean.statement:
def DerivedDegreeZeroExchangeEquation
    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ D) (H : A ⥤ C) (J : C ⥤ D)
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [H.Additive] [J.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (e : F ⋙ G ⟶ H ⋙ J)
    (δ : F.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ G.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      H.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ J.rightDerivedFunctor)
    (cF : ∀ M : A,
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single B (.up ℤ) 0).obj (F.obj M)) ⟶
        F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single A (.up ℤ) 0).obj M)))
    (cJ : ∀ M : C,
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single D (.up ℤ) 0).obj (J.obj M)) ⟶
        J.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single C (.up ℤ) 0).obj M)))
    (pG : ∀ M : B,
      G.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single B (.up ℤ) 0).obj M)) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single D (.up ℤ) 0).obj (G.obj M)))
    (pH : ∀ M : A,
      H.mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single A (.up ℤ) 0).obj M)) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single C (.up ℤ) 0).obj (H.obj M)))
    (M : A) : Prop
